blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: This paper introduces a geometric approach to the representation and learning of time-variant parametrizations of deep assignment flows, for binary data labelings on graphs. Each edge carries an optimally controlled parameter flow in a 2-dimensional totally geodesic submanifold, based on objectives derived from a non-local linear scale space representation of the input data. The aggregation of triplets of such flows in 5-dimensional totally geodesic submanifolds is learned from data. The fusion of these flows determines the trajectory in the high-dimensional symmetric parameter space and by geometric integration the layers of binary deep assignment flows. Numerical results demonstrate the expressivity and the limitation of our highly parallel geometric local synthesis approach to high-dimensional deep assignment flow parametrizations.
blocks.zh: 本文为图上二进制数据标签引入了一种几何方法来表示和学习深任务流的时变参数化. 每个边缘都包含一个二维完全大地测量子磁倍中的最佳可控参数流,其取自输入数据非局部线性比例空间表示产生的目标. 从数据中可以了解到这种流动的三重体在五维完全大地测量子磁面上的集合。 这些流的聚变决定了高维对称参数空间的轨迹,并通过几何融合决定了二进制深分配流的地层. 数值结果显示,我们高度平行的几何局部合成方法对高维深度分配流参数化的表达性和局限性。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Geometric deep learning [ 4 ] constitutes an active and promising research direction. The fast growing literature includes works with a focus on manifold-valued data [ 5 , 9 ] , on the equivariance properties of mappings realized by deep networks [ 6 , 14 , 8 ] or on the application-specific sensitivity to spatial structure in terms of geometric control through sub-Riemannian geometry [ 15 , 3 ] . Apparently, less work has been devoted to studying the geometric role of the network parameters themselves for particular classes of deep networks.
blocks.zh: 几何深度学习[4]构成积极而有前途的研究方向. 快速增长的文献包括侧重于多值数据的作品[5,9],关于深层网络实现的测绘的等效性作品[6,14,8],或通过次里曼语几何学对空间结构进行几何控制的应用特异性敏感性作品[15,3]. 显然,研究网络参数本身对特定类别的深层网络的几何作用的工作较少。

blocks.en: 4 Experiments and Discussion
blocks.zh: 4 试验和讨论

blocks.en: 4.1 Data Sets
blocks.zh: 4.1 国家 数据集

blocks.en: We used the following data sets illustrated by Figure 4.1 . Rotated MNIST: a publicly available well-known data set [ 12 ] which generalizes the original MNIST data set. Data points were additionally corrupted (i) by selecting randomly two rows containing foreground pixels and changing all pixels in these rows to foreground; (ii) by interchanging fore- and background pixels afterwards. Thus the task is to simultaneously invert fore- and background and to correct false labelings. Dino scene: Images of computer-generated 3D scenes, turned into binary input labelings by thresholding. The task is to infer the foreground regions just from the irregular black-/white regions and the spatial context provided by the entire graph and local-to-global information aggregation, without using explicit shape information as provided e.g. by the silhouettes. This experiment mimics the famous psychophysical Dalmation dog experiment [ 7 , pp.20] which demonstrates the ability of the human visual system to infer object shapes from seemingly unorganized binary spatial patterns.
blocks.zh: 我们使用了图4.1所示的下列数据集。 旋转的 MNIST:一个公开的知名数据集[12],它概括了原来的 MNIST 数据集. 数据点被额外的腐蚀(一)通过随机选择包含前景像素的两行,并将这些行中的所有像素改为前景像素; (二)之后通过中间交换前像素和背景像素. 因此,任务是同时颠倒前题和背景,并纠正虚假标签。 迪诺场景: 计算机生成的3D场景的图像,通过阈值变为二进制输入标签. 任务是从不规则的黑/白区域推断前景区域,以及整个图表和从地方到全球的信息汇总所提供的空间背景,而不必使用诸如Silhouettes提供的明确形状信息。 这个实验模仿了著名的心理物理达摩犬实验[7,第20页],它证明了人类视觉系统从看似无组织二进制的空间模式推断物体形状的能力.

blocks.en:
Network architecture. The network architecture comprises 186.995 trainable parameters.
The temporal branch processes the time-dependent features via an LSTM cell with 56 hidden units, followed by a linear projection to 56 dimensions.
The static branch computes a 56-dimensional embedding of the input through a multilayer perceptron with hidden dimensions 256 and 512 and SiLU activations.
The two embeddings are added elementwise and passed through a 56-dimensional fusion layer and a final linear layer predicting the three S ​ O ​ ( 2 ) SO(2) rotation angles in ( 3.15 ). Since inference is done across the linear scale space (Section 3.3 ), the corresponding scale index d ∈ [ D ] d\in[D] was used as additional input datum.

静态分支通过多层透视器计算输入的56维嵌入,其隐藏维度为256和512以及SiLU激活.

The computation was done on a desktop computer with a NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Ti offering 16GB of VRAM.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion and Outlook
blocks.zh: 5 结论和展望

blocks.en: We introduced controlled binary assignment flows based on geometrically fusing optimal parameter trajectories in low-dimensional totally geodesic submanifolds. Our strategy of using cyclic subgraphs for representing high-dimensional point in the symmetric space ( 1.1g ) complements established strategies using acyclic subgraphs, or chordal subgraphs with low tree-width [ 17 ] , which may be of independent interest.
blocks.zh: 我们在低维完全大地测量子磁面上 引入了基于几何化的 优化参数轨迹的二进制分配流 我们使用循环子图在对称空间中代表高维点(1.1g)的策略补充了使用循环子图的既定策略,或者树宽度低的弦子图[17],这些策略可能具有独立的利益.

blocks.en: Regarding future work, the following topics are of particular interest. • Adaptive triangular subgraphs. Ideally, the two subgraphical structures depicted by Figure 4.2 should be learned from data, to enhance the adaptivity to different scenarios and to further improve prediction performance. • Adaptive scale space representation. Providing non-local contextual information eases both learning and inference and enables to reduce the number of parameters. Using adaptive scale selection and possibly non-linear scale spaces might be beneficial in this respect. • Using symmetry. The scenario ‘binary labeling’ and our approach to using a symmetric space entails symmetries of the parameter representation (cf. Figure 3.3 ), which have not yet been fully explored. Corresponding reductions might enable to consider large-scale scenarios efficiently regarding memory requirements and computation time. • Non-binary labelings. The non-binary case requires various generalizations. Yet, a better understanding of the preceding points should pave the way for tackling arbitrary labeling scenarios in a similar way.
blocks.zh: 关于今后的工作,以下专题特别值得注意。 • 适应性三角子图。 理想的是,图4.2所描绘的两个子图结构应该从数据中学习,以提高适应不同情景的适应性,并进一步提高预测性能. • 适应性空间代表性。 提供非本地背景信息既方便学习又方便推论,能够减少参数数量. 在这方面,利用适应性尺度选择和可能的非线性尺度空间可能是有益的。 • 使用对称性。 “二进制标签”和我们使用对称空间的方法涉及参数表示的对称性(见图3.3),这些参数尚未得到充分探讨。 相应的减少可以有效地考虑关于内存要求和计算时间的大规模设想。 • 非二进制标签。 非二进制案例需要各种概括. 然而,如能更好地了解上述各点,则应为以类似方式处理任意贴标签的情况铺平道路。
